principle: Features are enabled from observed data capabilities in the curated archive, not from race-name assumptions. Missing splits, geometry or demographic fields are never synthesized.

results_database.description: Searchable result database for the selected race/year.

finish_statistics.description: Finish distributions, placement statistics and participation summaries.

runner_or_team_profile.description: Individual/team result profile using only source-backed fields; missing demographic fields remain null.

split_analysis.description: Checkpoint and segment analysis using actual published split observations.

runner_replay.description: Interpolated replay between real timing observations on a verified locally usable route.

map_duel.description: Head-to-head map comparison driven by real timing observations and route interpolation.

course_difficulty_vs_pacing.description: Relates route characteristics to observed segment pacing.

course_version_records.description: Records and cross-year performance comparisons restricted to verified comparable course versions.

cross_year_participation.description: Participation trends across years. Demographic subviews must independently check field coverage.

gender_analysis.coverage_rule: Use only rows with source-backed sex; do not infer missing historical sex from names.

age_analysis.coverage_rule: Exact-age and age-category analyses are distinct. Never convert an age band into an exact age.

relay_member_display.description: Display Duo member rows in source sequence.

relay_leg_analysis.description: Leg-specific analysis remains disabled while leg_no is unverified.

repeat_runner_analysis.description: Requires a separate confidence-bearing linkage layer; source-local identities must not be overwritten.

ui_rule: Hide unsupported features or show a concise factual limitation. Never render an empty or fictional analysis by interpolating missing source data outside the explicitly defined replay model.
